title: Craft Blend 2-Mix Trio #26 (가로 띠 3구역·매끈 / 대각 띠 3구역·물결 / 세로 띠 3구역·매끈)
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio.

A photograph of THREE women standing side by side on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Left woman: a real adult Korean woman in her mid 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, a cold, commanding gaze, demure and soft, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.

Left woman's physique: An extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad. A commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist. Enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves. Not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Left woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way down her figure from the top and about 59% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Italian Deruta majolica (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre-yellow floral medallions), wide cobalt-and-ochre bands following the contours of the body, with repeating floral border filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Escher-inspired tessellation (a tessellating pattern of interlocking shapes that morph as they repeat), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with morphing tessellation filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Left woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Left woman's footwear: platform stiletto heels, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Center woman: a real adult Filipina woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, sultry, cool ash-brown hair styled in elegant updo, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish.

Center woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Center woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper left to the lower right as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 40% of the way down her figure from the top and about 69% of the way down her figure from the top. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it is painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, with geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating course, rippling softly rather than staying perfectly regular. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Center woman's pose: both hands on her hips, elbows out, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Center woman's footwear: ankle-strap stilettos, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Right woman: a real adult Nigerian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, demure and soft, bold vivid emerald-green hair styled in twin-tail, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, glossy finish.

Right woman's physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Right woman's body art: Her bare skin is painted with 2 different traditional patterns repeated across 3 regions of her figure. Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 21% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 72% of the way across her figure from her left edge. The regions alternate between 2 patterns in a repeating order. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic (a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions), wide cobalt bands following the contours of the body, with medallion scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern (a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with lattice linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it is painted in the same pattern as Region 1. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even course. Pigment on living skin throughout, covering every inch of her body below the jaw with no bare skin anywhere, face unpainted.

Right woman's pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of her body, every region clearly visible to the camera.

Right woman's footwear: extreme platform buckled boots, painted with the blended patterns following the same soft transitions as her skin.

Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, all faces toward the camera.

Lighting: the blended painted patterns reading crisp against each woman's skin, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 8K.
